proof_body:
by
  intro G _ S hne hS
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  have h1 : (1 : G) ∈ S := by simpa using hS x hx x hx
  have hinv : ∀ b ∈ S, b⁻¹ ∈ S := fun b hb => by simpa using hS 1 h1 b hb
  exact ⟨{ carrier := S
           mul_mem' := fun {a b} ha hb => by simpa using hS a ha b⁻¹ (hinv b hb)
           one_mem' := h1
           inv_mem' := fun {b} hb => hinv b hb }, rfl⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (S : Set G), S.Nonempty → (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, a * b⁻¹ ∈ S) → ∃ H : Subgroup G, (H : Set G) = S
